notes.title: DEVLOG: COSMIC FEAR - PROGRESS UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Welcome back to another devlog for my upcoming game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/]Cosmic Fear[/url]. I’m thrilled to share some exciting updates on the progress as I continue to bring this Lovecraftian horror adventure to life.

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
I've been crafting new environments that will take you deeper into the unknown.
The latest environments are inspired by some of the eeriest corners of the universe, blending Lovecraftian horror with breathtakingly beautiful yet haunting landscapes. I’m paying close attention to every detail, from the creepy soundscapes to the dynamic lighting effects, to ensure that each environment feels unique and contributes to the overall atmosphere of dread.

Here's a sneak peek at what I’ve been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg[/img]
I’m excited for you to explore these new areas and uncover the secrets they hold.


In addition to the world building, I’m also working on the save system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/95a12baf238c0f385012891dbc0557980ffb4091.jpg[/img]
Join me on Youtube!

I’m often live on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alessandroguzzo]Youtube channel[/url] where you can join me while I play games, as well as dive deep into game development discussions, share tips and tricks, and interact with you. It's a great way to stay connected, and I can't wait to see you there and chat with you all in real-time!


Don't forget to grab the Cosmic Horror bundle on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: COSMIC FEAR Announced! Wishlist now!
notes.content:
Exciting news, everyone! 
I'm thrilled to announce that the Steam page for my new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/]COSMIC FEAR[/url], is now live! 
Make sure to WISHLIST the game and help grow our community by sharing this exciting news.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/]COSMIC FEAR - WISHLIST NOW![/url]

[h3]Plot: [/h3]
Cosmic Fear is a disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure where you find yourself investigating on strange phenomena that occur in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like you're not the only one who's keeping an eye on them. 

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]

As a solo developer, this is a massive project that I've been working on for years after my second title The Alien Cube. 
I've transitioned from CryEngine to Unreal Engine 5, using the latest technologies to deliver cutting-edge graphics, an immersive atmosphere, and a deep, engaging story. 
Cosmic Fear expands the narrative of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/568930/The_Land_of_Pain/]The Land of Pain[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/]The Alien Cube[/url], introducing significant improvements and a broader, more immersive experience. 
The way the Lovecraftian theme was brought to life in my previous games was much appreciated, and with Cosmic Fear I'm confident this new adventure will captivate you even more. The dread and wonder of Lovecraft's universe will be more intense than ever. Each step you take will pull you further into the chilling depths of this cosmic horror experience. 

Help me reach more people! Every single share is crucial, and any help is greatly appreciated. 
I've also set up a newsletter on my website where you can sign up to receive the latest news and you’ll also have a chance to join the beta testing program. 

Thank you all for your amazing support!

notes.title: Lovecraftian Days and game development showcase!
notes.content:
Dear fellow cosmic horror enthusiasts, I’m thrilled to announce you that the Lovecraftian Days are here!
During this otherworldly event I will stream a timelapse video about my upcoming game, with behind-the-scenes glimpses into the game's creation. 

[h3]WATCH THE LIVESTREAM HERE ON THE ALIEN CUBE' S STORE PAGE:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/

[h3]Q&A[/h3]
During the livestream I will be available to answer your questions and talk about the development. Feel free to talk with with me in the broadcast chat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8af4cce7d7db31bc58478531e355ee58ef5b54e6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Unreal Engine 5[/h3]
I am developing the game with Unreal Engine 5, that allows to reach next-gen graphics through cutting-edge features such as: 
- Lumen Global Illumination: dynamic lighting that adapts to your every move, creating stunningly realistic scenes.
- Nanite Virtualized Geometry: a  system which allows to obtain an incredible level of detail for every object in the game. Nanite  to obtain an incredible level of detail without sacrificing performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8b353054f57aa452ea9aed4ef4b9bb2902a83bf4.jpg[/img]
[h3]About my new game[/h3]
This is going to be a cosmic-horror game focused on story and mystery, with realistic graphics and an immersive atmosphere.
In this chilling adventure you will have to face the inevitability of fate while exploring disturbing places, finding clues and studying ancient mysteries. 
Like my previous games, The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, the game is inspired by Lovecraftian literature.

[h3]🔮 Why Lovecraft?[/h3]
H.P. Lovecraft's cosmic horror legacy continues to captivate and terrify. His influence echoes through the ages, inspiring authors, artists and game developers from all over the world. Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works too, in particular his ability to place emphasis on the terror of the unknowable and incomprehensible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/3fe9069448ed1c43d98492cf130e6b3462c36245.jpg[/img]
[h3]Stay Tuned[/h3]
Follow our social media channels for updates, teasers and exclusive content. 
Last but not least, the Cosmic Horror Bundle will be on sale for the entire duration if the event!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

notes.title: The Land of Pain has been enhanced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/0d718ad61badb340b44800f3a0a95b098619b577.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone! A big update for The Land of Pain is now live!

On September 13th The Land of Pain will celebrate its fifth anniversary and I decided to make some nice improvements!

Here are some of the major changes:

-	Enhanced graphics with better rocks, fog and lights. 
-	Some puzzles improvements.
-	Less backtracking. 
-	Ultrawide support has been improved.
-	New secrets added.

Also some minor bugs have been fixed.

** Please note that the previous savegames are not compatible with this version; but don’t worry, you can continue from your last checkpoint by using the previous version:
-	On Steam Library, right-click on the game
-	Select “Properties” and choose the 2021 version from the “beta” tab

Now I’d like to share with you a comparison before and after the graphics improvement: 

BEFORE:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/bb71fe87b19384417b0e093d1482a3e9cc40e730.jpg[/img]
AFTER:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/69feafdad01af0e362f23fdd09a84999c25683f4.jpg[/img]

BEFORE:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/acb6dde4029a1f4367799a91bbbbf7d86b5d629e.jpg[/img]
AFTER:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/41e1541174b8fa75a4db0d13757324b135f95fd2.jpg[/img]

I improved the lights and adjusted the fog. I also implemented new rocks and natural elements to add realism to the game.

And for those of you who love to explore, you’ll be rewarded by finding more hidden artifacts!
Here’s a sneak peek of one of the secrets. Will you be able to find it? ;) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/452286f387025d07faa75b6fa528a285c079bc08.jpg[/img]

Lastly, I want to thank you all for your amazing support! The Land of Pain was my very first game and your feedback has been really helpful throughout the years. 

Make sure to check also the spiritual sequel The Alien Cube while waiting for my next game, a first person mysterious horror game! 

I can’t reveal too much for the moment, but soon I’ll share some news on my socials. 
Stay tuned ;)

notes.title: 2020 RECAP + UPCOMING THE ALIEN CUBE DEVLOG
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

This year is coming to an end and I want to wish you all a wonderful Christmas time!
I am really thankful for your enthusiasm and this year I decided to add a few upgrades in The Land of Pain.
I have improved the AI to have a better enemy chasing experience. This allows to have more dynamic situations, where players can better hide themselves and avoid dangerous situations if they play carefully.
I also wanted to include new languages to allow more people in the community to fully enjoy the game, so I have added Spanish and Russian translation.
Finally the texts visualization in the game has been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/7f7c3353929d267188bd76970a824a225238bffd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27862879/1a32f78c1267a39ecd6710fa102f7b5f8b8ccc82.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t played The Land of Pain yet, grab it now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/568930/The_Land_of_Pain/

I want to thank you all for the support over the years, so a new article will be out soon on The Alien Cube’s Steam page with unseen screenshots and videos!
In the meantime don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! ːsteamhappyː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/

Happy Holidays! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: My new game – The Alien Cube
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I’m happy to announce my new game: The Alien Cube 

The Alien Cube is a first person horror adventure focused on mystery and investigation.

Inspired by Lovecraftian tales, the game tells a completely new story, but there will be some interesting connections to the events happened in The Land of Pain that its fans will be happy to discover.

PLOT:
Your cousin Edgar has mysteriously disappeared. You decide to investigate, but a dreadful discovery will put your life in danger.
You will face strange happenings that will lead you to doubt your own perceptions. Uncover a horrifying secret and explore forbidden places to escape from the darkness that is haunting you.

There will be a wide variety of environments: explore ancient places and dungeons, walk in snowy forests, face hostile weather conditions, visit villages in the middle of nowhere and more. 

To find out more, follow me on my Steam Developer Page: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/aleguzzoDev/] STEAM DEV PAGE[/url]

notes.title: v 1.03 STAMINA IMPROVED, ARROW KEYS ADDED
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
the game has just been updated to version 1.03.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27862879/17ae1d1b89f5a867f5a78de054cec4a23526c32f.jpg[/img]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]

[u]1-ARROW KEYS AND LEFT-HANDED CONTROLS[/u]
I've added the following controls in addition to the default WASD (both controls are enabled):

Move - Arrowkeys
Sprint - Right Shift
Jump - Right CTRL
Crouch - Numpad 0


[u]2-IMPROVED PLAYER STAMINA DYNAMIC:[/u]
Now the player can run longer before he has to slow down.
The stamina will also regenerate faster and as soon as the player will start walking.
This will improve the escaping parts and the exploration sequences.

[u]3-Minor bugs fixes[/u]

Enjoy!
